Subject: Mutual Action Plan: MAP Draft & Timeline Options (Finovo / Redwood)

Hi Liam / Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Great conversation — I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft based on the discovery we ran through. Attached is a working spreadsheet and I also pasted a short summary below.

Quick summary / goals
- Objective: Proof-of-value (POV) + integration for Finovo fraud-detection assistant using Redwood hosted inference (private data flow).
- Target business outcome: reduce manual review volume by 40% and improve time-to-investigation by 30%.

Proposed milestones (initial draft)
1) MAP Kickoff & Scope sign-off — owner: Finovo (Liam) / Redwood (Marissa) — deliverable: accepted MAP doc. Target week: Mar 15 or Mar 22
2) Security & Compliance review (SOC 2 evidence + network diagram) — owner: Finovo security / Redwood security — dependency: Redwood to provide SOC2 report, architecture diagram (attached)
3) Tech integration & test harness (POC) — owner: Finovo engineering / Redwood SE (Rishi) — deliverable: working API integration + sample dataset
4) Pilot / Canary run (2 weeks) — owner: Finovo product / Redwood ops — deliverable: metrics report + quality review
5) Contract & Procurement (SOW + pricing) — owner: Finovo procurement / Redwood sales (Aisha) — deliverable: executed SOW
6) Production rollout & enablement — owner: Finovo engineering / Redwood CS (Connor)

Timeline options
- Option A (aggressive): Kickoff week of Mar 15 — target close & production by end of Q2 (2026-06-30)
- Option B (conservative): Kickoff week of Mar 22 — target close by mid Q3 (2026-07-31)

Immediate asks from your side
1) Please confirm which kickoff week you prefer (Mar 15 or Mar 22).
2) Confirm the internal stakeholders we should add to the MAP (legal, procurement, product, engineering manager).
3) Any hard constraints on target close / budget timing.

Attachments / links
- 20260304-Finovo-MAP-draft.xlsx (attached)
- Finovo_Discovery_Notes.pdf (attached)
- MAP (working doc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdEFgFinovoMAPDraft

I'll loop in Rishi (SE) and Connor (CS) to help scope integration work once you confirm stakeholders. If easier, happy to run a 30-min MAP kickoff next week.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191
